senses.gloss: (I)--Name of a god with the Hemanta sun; a तुषित god. Br. II. २३. १६; ३६. ११.
(III)--the राक्षस who resides in the sun's chariot during the month of मार्गशीर्ष. Vi. II. १०. १३.

(II)--the name of the sun in the month of Saha (मार्गशीर्ष).
1: भा. XII. ११. ४१.
the आदित्य of the month Citra, possessing ७००० rays.
2: Br. II. २४. ३४ and ३८.
An आदित्य.
3: Br. III. 3. ६७; Vi. I. १५. १३१.
(III)--one of the ten devas of the Harita गण। वा. १००. ८९.
(IV)--The son of Purumitra and father of Sat- vata. Vi. IV. १२. ४३.

(I)--son of असमञ्ज(sa)(s), devoted to grandfather Sagara.
1: भा. IX. 8. १५; Br. III. ५१. ५१; ५२. 1; M. १२. ४३; वा. ८८. १६६; Vi. IV. 4. 7-३२.
Went in search of the consecrated horse of Sagara, met Kapila and belauded his greatness.
2: भा. IX. 8. १९. २७; Br. III. ५४. १७ and ५१.
Pleased with him, Kapila sent back the horse, adding that the सागरस् would obtain release by the waters of the Ganges.
3: भा. IX. 8. २८-29; Br. III. ५६. २९.
Succeeded Sagara as king.
4: भा. IX. 8. २८, ३१.
Was engaged in penance to get the गङ्गा for the liberation of his uncles. Before he could achieve this, he died. His son was दिलीप.
5: भा. IX. 9. 1-2; Br. III. ५६. ३०; ६३. १६५; Vi. IV. 4. ३४.
Anointing him, अंशुमत् retired to the forest.
(II)--one of the यादवस् deputed to go with कृष्ण's sacrificial horse with a view to its protection. भा. X. ८९. २२[3]. [page१-093+ ३२]
(IV)--the son of पञ्चजन; married यशोदा, mindborn daughter of हविष्मन्त Pitr2s: Father of दिलीप. M. १५. १८.
(V)--a son of कौशिक: in previous births born as चक्रवाक in मानस. M. २०. १८.
(VI)--a horse of the moon's chariot. M. १२६. ५२.
